docs.author: Dr. Samuel Oyelaran
sentences: Patient is a 40-year-old man with low back pain for about two months.
Sleeps about six hours a night.
No fever, weight loss, saddle numbness or cancer history.
Symptoms persist after more than two months of physical therapy and daily naproxen.
Reports numbness and tingling along the outer left calf.
Plan: MRI of the lumbar spine without contrast.
docs.title: Orthopedic clinic visit note

payer_letter: Northwind Health has reviewed claim A-1029 for MRI of the lumbar spine. Coverage requires documentation of at least six weeks of conservative treatment or a red flag condition. The records submitted do not document at least six weeks of conservative treatment before imaging. You may request reconsideration within 180 days of this notice.
